_doc: Policy for dynamic mine-network (game/fleet/mine_net.py). Auto-rotates miners across unsaturated belts (>=15% floor), matching fitted tools, prioritizing reserve/needs.tsv shortages, skipping full reserves, and stamping instant cooldowns on floor breach.
_zero_note: 2026-11-24 14:51 UTC (Zero): deposit_stations = the five home stations where give-miner-stores-* routes and receivers stand (a store elsewhere is stranded under strict classes); market_tier false: a miner sells nothing (P5), so ore the reserve does not lack is not mined for the market; priority_resources silicon_ore: the reserve's dearest short raw good (42,013 short, surplus.py reserve 14:30 UTC); iron comes from supply_status while it reads short.
